notes:
New Features:

- 2 h IPTV Check now offers One Channel before the m3u4u groups. Start IPTV Check opens a channel picker for this scope, while IPTV Auto Check can bind the selected time directly to a manually started Adult IPTV channel.

Improvements:

- One Channel uses the same selected 15 min./30 min./1 h/2 h hold time but never advances to another sender after the chosen channel finishes its test window.
- Group checks keep the exact m3u4u source order and the existing wrap-around behaviour from a manually started channel.

Bugfixes:

- Repairs m3u4u-to-Kodi PVR matching for playlist display names such as (Dorcel TV (576p)) (Cumination Add-on), which previously produced a zero-channel 2 h IPTV plan even though the group was populated.
- Normalizes the known Penthouse Gold HD/Penthouse Gold and Penthouse Passion TV/Penthouse Passion naming differences without merging distinct channels such as Hustler HD and Hustler TV.
